# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
For failed items, check the regulations.
3. For each failed item enter the appropriate failed item code.
4. Next enter the comments for ALL the parts of that failed item.
5. Enter failed test codes and comments for any accessories or extension leads.
6. For each failed item, check the regulations.
7. For the affected appliance, document the appropriate replacement code.
8. For accessories and extension leads, no further action is necessary until they are tested.
